changelog: Fixed: per-device bandwidth limits no longer collide — each device now gets a unique traffic-control mark (previously two devices could share one mark and silently clobber each other)
Fixed: kernel network settings (reverse-path filter, forwarding tunables, queue length) are now saved on start and fully restored when the app stops
Improved: updating is now more reliable — the app verifies the new version installed before finishing, and always relaunches cleanly instead of leaving a duplicate running
Fixed: paid features now stay locked until your account plan is confirmed
Added: a 'Later' option after an update so you can keep working and restart when ready
Fixed: leftover backup files are now cleaned from the install folder after each update
Fixed: app logo now shows correctly across all screens (dashboard, AI setup, AutoPilot)
Added: back button on the AI setup page to return to the dashboard
